info.title: ClariTalk Backend API
info.description: This is the OpenAPI specification for the ClariTalk backend API. It defines the available endpoints, request/response formats, and other relevant information about the API.

error.example: Resend is not currently available. Please try again later.

idToken.description: Google ID token returned by Google Identity Services

message.example: Resend is not currently available. Please try again later.

resetToken.description: Password reset token to be used in /auth/reset-password.

phrase.description: Base phrase text. Validation uses editedPhrase when provided, otherwise phrase.

editedPhrase.description: Optional user-edited text for master phrase evaluation. Supported only when isCustomPhrase is false.

isCustomPhrase.description: True for custom phrases, false for master phrase

phraseId.description: Required when isCustomPhrase is false (master phrase flow)

customPhraseId.description: Optional when isCustomPhrase is true. If provided, rerecords by replacing the existing recording for this custom phrase.

audio_sample.description: Audio sample file for environment check

EnvironmentCheckResponse.description: Response forwarded from the Python environment check service.

therapyPlanId.description: Required when starting a new session (sessionId is null)

exercises.description: Present in latest-plan response; absent in day-detail and complete-day responses

meta.description: Source exercise data from the AI plan

ws.description: Connect with /notifications/ws?token=<accessToken>. Emits notification.connected, notification.hydrate, and notification.created events. On notification.hydrate, call GET /notifications to fetch the latest state.

post.description: Send a freeform message to the LangGraph-based therapy companion. Returns the AI response and updated session position.

404.description: Therapy plan or companion session not found

get.summary: Get the latest therapy plan
get.description: Returns the most recent therapy plan with hydrated days, exercises, attempt counts, and completion summary. Auto-hydrates day/exercise rows from AI plan JSON on first access.

200.description: Latest therapy plan with days and exercises

get.summary: Get day detail
get.description: Returns exercises with all recorded attempts and daily feedback state for a specific day.

parameters.name: dayNumber
parameters.description: Day number within the therapy plan

200.description: Day detail with exercises and attempts

post.description: Upload patient audio for a specific set/rep. The audio is validated, stored in Azure Blob, and sent to the AI service for scoring. Replaces any existing attempt for the same set/rep.

200.description: Evaluation result with AI score and feedback

400.description: Missing file or invalid set/rep number

post.description: Mark a physical/non-recorded exercise rep as complete without audio upload. Only allowed for exercises with isVerbal=false.

400.description: Validation error or exercise is verbal

post.description: Generate a reference audio demonstration for a therapy exercise via AI TTS. Returns binary audio.
Convert exercise instructions/steps to speech via AI TTS. Returns binary audio (WAV).
Transcribe patient audio using a dysarthria-optimized Whisper model.
Generate AI-powered daily check-in questions for a therapy day. Previous days' questions are used as context to avoid repetition.
Submit answers to the daily check-in questions, or skip the feedback entirely.

400.description: Invalid day number or feedback questions not yet generated

post.description: Returns the patient weekly progress report PDF immediately. Clinician report and final JSON report persistence are generated asynchronously in the background.

404.description: No plan found for that week

get.summary: Get current exercise position for a day
get.description: Returns the current rep, set, and exercise the user needs to do for the given day. Derives position by comparing completed attempts against prescribed sets and reps.

parameters.name: dayNumber
parameters.description: Day number within the therapy plan

get.summary: List or search companion chat sessions
get.description: Returns a paginated list of the authenticated user's companion chat sessions, ordered by most recently updated. Provide q to perform a case-insensitive title search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional search query matched against session title (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of sessions to return (1–100)

get.summary: Get chat session history
get.description: Returns the message history for a specific companion chat session.
